headline: Fire Commission

meeting.summary: The Fire and Public Safety Commission met on Thursday, October 15, 2026.
meeting.recap: The Fire and Public Safety Commission met on Thursday, October 15, 2026.[[0:00:32]] Members approved the last meeting's minutes with two corrections, with six in favor and one abstaining.[[0:05:14]] The fire chief said the Kīhei fire station site study went to the County Council.[[0:11:19]] Two unexpected grants will pay for equipment that can now come off the FY28 budget request.[[0:12:22]] The study looked at five sites, and the top two are private properties.[[0:15:16]] Of 45 people who passed the ocean safety test, only three passed the agility test.[[0:19:01]] The chief said new speed bumps likely add to a four-second rise in average response time.[[0:24:13]] The deputy chief said paying for new fire trucks fully up front earns the county a discount.[[0:27:07]] A large emergency exercise is planned for December 9.[[0:49:16]] The department expects to start a new firefighter recruit class in February.[[0:53:58]] The chief presented the department's FY28 budget request.[[1:23:45]] The request includes two captain positions to help build a new fire dispatch center.[[1:25:01]] Haʻikū Fire Station approval is waiting to be placed on a County Council agenda.[[1:58:04]] The commission adjourned until January 21, 2027.[[2:13:16]]
decided: The minutes of the last regular meeting were approved with two corrections.
The meeting was adjourned until January 21, 2027; no vote was heard on the recording.
meeting.next: The chief will notify commissioners as soon as the Haʻikū Fire Station makes a council agenda. The commission will not meet in November or December.

moments.q: Kīhei fire station site options explained
"Don't sugarcoat it. People have died here."
